title: SoK: Market Microstructure for Decentralized Prediction Markets (DePMs)
abstract: arXiv:2510.15612v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decentralized prediction markets (DePMs) allow open participation in event-based wagering without fully relying on centralized intermediaries. We review the history of DePMs which date back to 2011 and includes hundreds of proposals. Perhaps surprising, modern DePMs like Polymarket deviate materially from earlier designs like Truthcoin and Augur v1. We use our review to present a modular workflow comprising eight stages: underlying infrastructure, market topic, share structure and pricing, market initialization, trading, market resolution, settlement, and archiving. For each module, we enumerate the design variants, analyzing trade-offs around decentralization, expressiveness, and manipulation resistance. We also identify open problems for researchers interested in this ecosystem.

translated_title: SoK：去中心化预测市场的微观结构
translated_abstract: 去中心化预测市场允许人们在无需完全依赖中心化中介的情况下，公开参与基于事件的投注。我们回顾了可追溯至2011年的去中心化预测市场历史，其中包含数百项提案。或许令人惊讶的是，以Polymarket为代表的现代去中心化预测市场与Truthcoin和Augur v1等早期设计存在实质性差异。基于这一回顾，我们提出了一个包含八个阶段的模块化工作流程：底层基础设施、市场主题、份额结构与定价、市场初始化、交易、市场裁决、结算和归档。针对每个模块，我们列举了各种设计变体，并分析了围绕去中心化、表达能力和抗操纵性的权衡。我们还为对此生态系统感兴趣的研究人员指明了有待解决的问题。
tldr: 本文系统化梳理了去中心化预测市场自2011年以来的发展历史，提出了涵盖八个阶段的模块化工作流程，并逐一分析各模块设计在去中心化、表达能力与抗操纵性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This SoK systematizes the history of decentralized prediction markets dating back to 2011, presents a modular eight-stage workflow, and analyzes design trade-offs across decentralization, expressiveness, and manipulation resistance for each module.
